long_biography.plain_text:
Reza Zarrab founded Royal Maritime as his first Turkish company in 2008, before establishing Royal Holding with several partners two years later. The maritime business supplied five restaurant vessels for a Moscow hotel, giving the young group an operating project beyond financial trading.

As chairman and sole board member of the holding company, Zarrab worked in Turkey under the name Rıza Sarraf. Its subsidiaries extended into furniture, aviation and hospitality, and the separate businesses were eventually consolidated at one Istanbul address. The group structure placed distinct ventures under central private control while retaining specialist operating companies.
